interpretation: Finite frozen cases, not general planar-graph coverage. Both modes use intersections and original-cycle closure; only common-context cycle propagation differs. Gap/control solutions are independently exhausted against original edges and fixed colors. Structured projections compare every saved scope with all global solutions, subject to explicit projection limits. Random SAT cases preserve one frozen independent witness only; random UNSAT statuses use frozen exhaustive-search references. Domains, original input relations and saved complete reconstruction choices are checked without requiring a unique solution. Discovery and relation caps may omit optional propagators; a finished prescribed cycle scan is not an all-cycles claim. Limits remain inconclusive; truncated traces reduce recorded coverage. No timing criterion or speculative writeback.
